findings.message: Clamp-active positive scalar B2 inputs cannot retain unchanged source-equilibrium forces, original physical section compliance and exact operator energy/work recovery simultaneously. Source-equation defect is strictly positive for nonzero clamped shear; this blocks the original full-positive-domain recovery claim, not validity of this adjudication artifact.

scope.acceptance_boundary: Accepts the source-bound blocked MO16 adjudication only; no mechanics execution, recovery implementation, domain reduction, changed operator, full G3c qualification or production/default authority.
scope.q4_disposition: OPEN: existing linear recovery and naive single-Beff summation do not satisfy finite source work; general nonexistence is not proved.
scope.successor_authority: Changing the required exact scalar B2 operator/route requires specific reviewed successor authority; preserving public legacy B2 alone does not waive that constraint.
